info.title: WithinTech-Learn API
info.description: REST API for the WithinTech-Learn LMS platform.

200.description: Login successful. Sets `wt_access` (15m) and `wt_refresh` (7d) httpOnly cookies.

201.description: Account created — email verification OTP sent.

post.description: Verifies the user's email using the 6-digit OTP sent during sign-up or login (unverified). Returns access and refresh tokens on success.
Sends a new verification OTP to the given email.

post.summary: Sign in / sign up with Google
post.description: Verifies a Google ID token. Creates an account if none exists. Rejects if email is registered with email/password. Sets httpOnly auth cookies on success.
Reads the `wt_refresh` httpOnly cookie. Sets a new `wt_access` cookie (15m). No request body required.

200.description: New access token issued via cookie.

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the given email if an account exists.

200.description: Password reset, accessToken + refreshToken + user returned

post.description: Multipart form upload. Field name: `image`. Replaces existing thumbnail.

200.description: Thumbnail uploaded. Returns storageKey and signed URL.

post.summary: Add a module to a course
Add a block to a module
post.description: For `text` blocks supply `content`. For `image` blocks supply optional `caption`. For `code` blocks supply `content` and `language` (html|css|javascript|python). Upload images separately via the upload-image endpoint.

200.description: Ordered list of blocks. Image blocks include a signed `url`.

patch.summary: Update a block (text content, image caption, or code content/language)

post.summary: Upload image for an image block
post.description: Block must exist and be of type `image`. Multipart form upload. Field name: `image`. Replaces existing image.

200.description: Image uploaded. Returns storageKey and signed URL.

get.summary: Get quiz for a module (null if none exists)
Get quiz for a course (null if none exists)
Get quiz with questions and options

delete.summary: Delete a quiz (cascades questions and options)

post.summary: Add a question to a quiz
Add an option to a question

delete.description: Cannot delete the last correct option for a question.

400.description: Validation error or email already in use

get.summary: List users with optional search, filter and sort

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by first name, last name or email (case-insensitive)

get.description: Monthly enrolled vs completed counts for the last 12 months.
Top 5 published courses ranked by enrollment count with completion rates.
Counts students who enrolled in 2+ courses (returning students).
Distinct students who completed at least one module per day. Max 30-day window.

200.description: Array of daily active learner counts

get.description: New user registrations per day. Max 30-day window.
Published courses ranked by average days from enrollment to passing (fastest first). Only includes courses with at least one passing student.

200.description: Array of courses with completion duration stats

get.description: Returns all student enrollments with optional filters for student name or course title.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by student first or last name (case-insensitive)

get.summary: Get module progress for an enrollment
get.description: Returns module-level completion progress for a specific student enrollment.
Returns up to 3 published courses: (1) most enrolled, (2) latest by creation date, (3) a random pick from the rest. No authentication required.

get.summary: List published courses with enrollment status
get.description: Returns a paginated list of published courses including enrollment status for the authenticated student. Supports search and filter.

get.summary: Get a published course by slug

200.description: Course detail with modules, quiz, and enrollment status

get.description: Returns module blocks and quiz. Requires enrollment. Returns 403 if any previous module has not been completed (sequential progression enforced).

200.description: Module content with blocks, quiz, and last attempt

post.description: Sets enrollment status to PASSED. Requires all modules to be done. If the course has a quiz, the student must have passed it first.
Saves module progress. Requires all previous modules to be completed (sequential progression). If the module has a quiz, the student must have passed it first.

post.summary: Submit and mark a quiz attempt

get.summary: List all certificates earned by the authenticated student
Get certificate by userId and course slug
get.description: Public endpoint — no authentication required. Returns certificate info for display.
